instruction: Set up Ubuntu to use systemd-resolved for DNS resolution instead of the default configuration.

metadata.explanation: This task involves modifying DNS resolution configuration, including /etc/resolv.conf symlinks and systemd-resolved settings. Verification would require checking network service states and DNS resolution behavior, which cannot be reliably evaluated in the current framework.
